description.zh:
用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。
> 由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符，且该参数值中不能包含非ASCII字符。
description.en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

> You can use the client to generate the value, but you must ensure that it is unique among different requests. The token can only contain ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.
The ID of the instance. You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](~~26232~~) operation to query the ID of the instance.

descriptions.en: The DestroyDBInstance operation is phased out.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun rds destroy-db-instance --client-token ETnLKlblzczshOTUbOCziJZNwH0000 --db-instance-id rm-uf6wjk50000 --region cn-hangzhou
